Class Stats

java.lang.Object
model.core.Stats
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Stats extends Object implements Cloneable
Class representing the combat statistics of a character in the RPG game.

It stores the core attributes: health, attack power, defense, and speed. This class is designed to be Cloneable to facilitate resetting character stats. It also implements PropertyChangeSupport to notify listeners (e.g., UI elements like health bars) when stats change.

      public void setHealth(int health)
